note: Atkinson County GA has no county zoning: its 2018 joint comprehensive plan says the county had no zoning and recommends adopting a county zoning ordinance; the 2012 work program lists developing a county zoning ordinance as a pending project. Pearson has a zoning appendix in its Municode code, but no zoning district polygons or GIS layer were found for Pearson, Willacoochee or Hoboken. ArcGIS search for Atkinson and Pearson zoning returned nothing. Only a commercial parcel aggregator (Regrid) carries zoning codes, which is not an official source.
